issues.description: Docs do not say that cad slice reports one combined time/weight for all parts on one plate; per-part numbers are not shown.
Not stated that kind='nut' puts the pocket on the exit side of a through-drill (it does, at the part bottom); verified via section render.
cad inspect lists nut pockets neither as holes nor with dimensions unless I read --features; I verified the hex pocket via measure --section z=1.5 instead.

Docs don't say which end the nut pocket goes for screw_hole(kind='nut') (it is at the far end of the drill direction, which worked here), nor that bottom_chamfer on a print_on part chamfers the printed bed face.
screw_hole kind=nut does not list the hex pocket in `cad inspect` holes (only the 4.5 clearance hole); I verified the pocket via a z-section and a section render.
Docs don't say where the nut pocket ends up, or that a 3D 'at' (x,y,30) is needed for the counterbore on a part that doesn't start at Z=0; worked by trial.
cad slice reports one combined time/weight for both parts, not per part, so PRINT.md gives the combined figure.

suggestions.suggestion: Report per-part print time/grams in cad slice output.
Add a pipe-clamp example with split halves, nut pockets and counterbores.
Document which side screw_hole(kind='nut') places the pocket.
List nut pockets and counterbores in cad inspect's hole summary with across-flats and depth.
cad slice with several parts could report per-part time/grams by default as well as the combined plate.
Give a worked two-half clamp example (split bore, print_on).
List nut pockets in cad inspect holes (AF, depth, Z range).
Per-part time/grams in cad slice output.
Screw-length fit check for head/nut stack.
